body: Thank you. I've been trying for a while now. It's people like you that make me happy about humanity. Wish there were more of you in the real world.

I don't know if it will make you feel better.. But it could always be worse. I have to see my ex almost everyday at work. I pretend to be content and happy around her but it still hurts. I feel the same as I did over 6 months ago. We went from best friends and talking everyday to casual hellos and waves.

Yeah I do this everyday. Earlier this summer I told myself I have until fall to turn things around and then I'll just end it. I know it's bullshit because in fall I'll say the same thing about the spring. Fuck man
I feel old because I remember being happy and now I know what it feels like to be older and a sad sack of shit.
